integrity: Equations are analytic results with a standalone symbolic/numerical corroboration program. No independent mathematical assessment or experimental validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to independent overdamped Brownian particles sharing a symmetric two-state Markov-switching harmonic stiffness \(k\pm h\), with \(k>h>0\), \(D>0\), and \(r>0\). Does not cover hydrodynamic interactions, asymmetric clocks, nonlinear traps, or finite-sample estimation. Broad Markov-modulated OU moment and autocovariance representations are prior art, and independently evaluated priority is not certified.
title: A sharp temporal mode exchange in fourth-order correlations of a switching harmonic Brownian gas
